    # Advance simulation for one timestep for all modules
    driver.Advance(step_size)
    terrain.Advance(step_size)
    vehicle.Advance(step_size)
    vis.Advance(step_size)

    # Increment frame number
    step_number += 1

    # Spin in place for real time to catch up
    realtime_timer.Spin(step_size)

import pychrono as chrono
import pychrono.irrlicht as chronoirr
import pychrono.core as chcore
import pychrono.postprocess as chpost

# Initialize PyChrono environment
chrono.Ch纪元()
system = chrono.ChSystemNSC()

# Load terrain
terrain = chrono.ChRigidTerrain()
terrain.SetGWorld(chrono.ChVectorD(0, 0, 0))
terrain.SetFriction(0.5)
terrain.SetRestitution(0.1)
terrain.SetElasticity(0.0)
terrain.SetGravity(chrono.ChVectorD(0, -9.81, 0))
terrain.SetTexture(chrono.ChTexture("terrain.png"))

# Add terrain to the system
system.Add(terrain)

# Load FEDA vehicle model
vehicle = chrono.ChVehicleFEDA()
vehicle.Initialize(system)
vehicle.SetPos(chrono.ChVectorD(0, 0, 0))
vehicle.SetRot(chrono.Q_from_AngX(chrono.CH_C_PI / 4))
vehicle.SetContactMethod(chrono.ChContactMethod.SPHERICAL)
vehicle.SetTireModel(chrono.ChTireModel.FULL)

# Set initial velocity
vehicle.SetVel(chrono.ChVectorD(0, 5, 0))

# Set camera to follow the vehicle
camera = chronoirr.ChIrrApp.NewCameraLookAt(chrono.ChVectorD(10, 10, 10), vehicle.GetPos(), chrono.ChVectorD(0, 0, 0))
camera.SetVRMode(False)
camera.SetVRWindowSize(800, 600)
camera.SetVRFramerate(50)

# Add vehicle to the system
system.Add(vehicle)

# Load mesh visualization for vehicle parts
vehicle.SetMeshVisualizationType(chcore.ChMeshVisualizationType.MESH_VISUALIZATION_TYPE_3D)

# Set Irrlicht visualization
app = chronoirr.ChIrrApp(system, "FEDA Vehicle Simulation", chronoirr.SIUnits::mToMeter)
app.AddTypicalSky()
app.AddTypicalLogo("logo水印.png")
app.AddTypicalCamera(chrono.ChVectorD(10, 10, 10), chrono.ChVectorD(0, 0, 0))
app.AddTypicalLights()
app.AddTypicalLights(True)
app.AddTypicalUI()

# Driver system for controlling vehicle dynamics
driver = chpost.ChDriverSteeringThrottleBrake()
driver.SetVehicle(vehicle)
driver.SetSteeringAngle(chrono.CH_C_PI / 4)
driver.SetThrottle(1)
driver.SetBrake(0)

# Simulation loop
while app.GetDevice().run():
    # Update driver inputs
    driver.UpdateInputs()
    # Update vehicle dynamics
    system.DoStepDynamics(1 / 50)
    # Render the scene
    app.BeginScene(True, True, chrono.ChColorB(0.5, 0.5, 0.5))
    app.DrawAll()
    app.EndScene()

# Finalize PyChrono environment
chrono.Ch纪元().Finalize()

driver = veh.ChPathFollowerDriver(vis, path, target_speed, look_ahead_distance, steering_gain, speed_gain)

# Set the time response for steering and throttle keyboard inputs.
steering_time = 1.0  # time to go from 0 to +1 (or from 0 to -1)
throttle_time = 1.0  # time to go from 0 to +1
braking_time = 0.3   # time to go from 0 to +1
driver.SetSteeringDelta(render_step_size / steering_time)
driver.SetThrottleDelta(render_step_size / throttle_time)
driver.SetBrakingDelta(render_step_size / braking_time)

driver.Initialize()

# output vehicle mass
print( "VEHICLE MASS: ",  vehicle.GetVehicle().GetMass())

# Number of simulation steps between miscellaneous events
render_steps = math.ceil(render_step_size / step_size)

# Initialize simulation frame counter s
realtime_timer = chrono.ChRealtimeStepTimer()
step_number = 0
render_frame = 0

while vis.Run() :
    time = vehicle.GetSystem().GetChTime()

    # Render scene and output POV-Ray data
    if (step_number % render_steps == 0) :
        vis.BeginScene()
        vis.Render()
        vis.EndScene()
        render_frame += 1

    # Get driver inputs
    driver_inputs = driver.GetInputs()

    # Update modules (process inputs from other modules)
    driver.Synchronize(time)
    terrain.Synchronize(time)
    vehicle.Synchronize(time, driver_inputs, terrain)
    vis.Synchronize(time, driver_inputs)

    # Advance simulation for one timestep for all modules
    driver.Advance(step_size)
    terrain.Advance(step_size)
    vehicle.Advance(step_size)
    vis.Advance(step_size)

    # Increment frame number
    step_number += 1

    # Spin in place for real time to catch up
    realtime_timer.Spin(step_size)
